cards.name: Drowned Secrets
cards.oracleText: Whenever you cast a blue spell, target player mills two cards.

cards.name: Mausoleum Secrets
cards.oracleText: Undergrowth — Search your library for a black card with mana value less than or equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

cards.name: Rakshasa's Secret
cards.oracleText: Target opponent discards two cards. You mill two cards.

cards.name: Secrets of the Golden City
cards.oracleText:
Ascend (If you control ten or more permanents, you get the city's blessing for the rest of the game.)
Draw two cards. If you have the city's blessing, draw three cards instead.

cards.name: Secrets of the Dead
cards.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell from your graveyard, draw a card.

cards.name: Trade Secrets
cards.oracleText: Target opponent draws two cards, then you draw up to four cards. That opponent may repeat this process as many times as they choose.

cards.name: Secrets of the Key
